Chapter 913: Chapter 14 The Confusion of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss (Please Subscribe)

Lin Yuan stepped into the Seventh Realm of Time-Space without any obstacles.

When a great amount of spiritual enlightenment converged, Lin Yuan realized the essence of the Seventh Realm of Time-Space.

Lin Yuan’s accumulation was too profound, coupled with the Immortal Realm’s special cultivation environment and the scenes from the Origin of the Immortal Realm condensed by the source of immortality, among others.

The result of many layers of foundation overlapping.

Of course, among all the foundations, the most crucial was Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

Without Against-Heaven’s Understanding to integrate everything, even if the conditions mentioned above were strengthened tenfold, it would be meaningless.

Within the Immortal Realm, which of the Direct Disciples of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path did not have a cultivation environment and resources superior to Lin Yuan’s? Some could even directly enter the Origin of the Immortal Realm to cultivate.

But so far, none of the Ancestral Master’s Disciples have stepped into the Seventh Realm in their comprehension of time-space.

Not to mention the disciples of the Ancestral Master, even the Ancestral Master himself has never touched the Seventh Realm regarding time-space understanding.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan came to a realization, and after reaching the Seventh Realm of time-space comprehension, the time-space he felt seemed to come alive.

It was not that time-space had come alive, but rather that time-space was always alive, constantly changing; Lin Yuan was previously unable to feel or observe it.

“Time-space, this is time-space!”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was distant, and the time-space of the entire Immortal Realm became completely visible to him, and even the time-space of the Demon Abyss beyond the Immortal Realm became apparent in his eyes.

“It turns out that the Immortal Realm and the Demon Abyss are the same world, but because the fundamental rules are different, obvious distinctions arise.” Lin Yuan suddenly understood.

Previously, he thought that the Demon Abyss was just a layer within the space of the Immortal Realm, but in fact, the Demon Abyss belongs to the main space of the Immortal Realm, and to the Demon Abyss, the Immortal Realm might not even hold a dominant position.

The Immortal Realm and the Demon Abyss are equal, with no distinction of primary and secondary.

“Hmm?”

“A subordinate world of the Immortal Realm?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, following the vast and endless power of time-space, he looked beyond the Immortal Realm.

The realm of the Immortal Realm is supremely lofty, at the pinnacle of this dimension.

However, below the Immortal Realm, there are three thousand three hundred and thirty-three worlds rising and falling.

Among these three thousand three hundred and thirty-three worlds, the Spirit Realm where Lin Yuan once descended was unmistakably among them.

And below these three thousand three hundred and thirty-three worlds, each world is connected to over a million lower-level worlds, including the world of the Central Divine China.

“Three thousand three hundred and thirty-three? This number again?”

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment, then withdrew his gaze.

With his current mastery over time-space, if he wished, he could descend to any world within this dimension.

But it’s meaningless.

Lower-level worlds would probably struggle even to accommodate Lin Yuan, like how the world of Central Divine China previously would have been smaller than the world within Lin Yuan’s body; what good would descending there do?

“My current strength…”

Lin Yuan began to review his own strength.

According to the information left by Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master, normally only a twelfth-layer sovereign could reach the Seventh Realm of Time-Space.

A few of the very top Path Splitting twelfth layers also have a chance to touch it.

That is to say, with only his comprehension of time-space, Lin Yuan is now superior to the vast majority of twelfth-layer Path Splitting beings.

With time-space comprehension, in direct combat, Lin Yuan is not a match for the ultimate twelfth layers, but he can completely use his comprehension of time-space to ‘play with’ those ultimate twelfth layers.

Just like with the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which obviously opens once every tens of thousands of years deep within the main universe’s time-space, yet all the ultimate twelfth layers can’t lock onto its coordinates.

This is suppression from the rule level.

“This is the Seventh Realm of Time-Space.”

Lin Yuan thought rapidly to himself.

For nearly all life forms, the difficulty of realizing the Seventh Realm of Time-Space is greater than achieving the ultimate form.

After all, most of the twelfth-layer Path Splitting realm powerhouses have not reached the Seventh Realm in their time-space comprehension.

“Now I…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred, and after his comprehension of time-space entered the Seventh Realm, with but a thought, his true body and Primordial Spirit, as well as his many avatars, all merged into the depths of time-space.

Even the ultimate twelfth layers couldn’t detect the slightest trace unless Lin Yuan chose to reveal himself.

Simply put, the current Lin Yuan is like a high-dimensional observer; even the ultimate twelfth layers are unable to perceive him if their rule comprehension hasn’t reached a certain height.

“Time-Space can be used in this way too?”

Lin Yuan continued to sense the changes within himself.

After reaching the Seventh Realm of time-space comprehension, the vast time-space before Lin Yuan’s eyes seemed to change its appearance, and many previously incomprehensible mysteries of time-space were now all deciphered effortlessly.

…

While Lin Yuan continued to meditate and familiarize himself with the Seventh Realm of Time-Space.

Outside the cave dwelling, the Immortal City’s Lord and numerous high-ranking powerhouses gathered.

They looked nervous and slightly uneasy, sensing that Lin Yuan’s dwelling was out of sync with the surrounding environment, and speculating that Lin Yuan might be related to the one who took action against those demonic beings outside the city.

After short communications, the Immortal City’s Lord and the high-ranking powerhouses left Cangwu Immortal City, which had nearly become ruins, to visit Lin Yuan at the first opportunity.

They had no choice.

If Lin Yuan really was related to that powerful being who had acted, their first task wasn’t to restore Cangwu Immortal City but to understand the thoughts of that powerful existence.

As well as to see if there were any demands.

After all, the intervention couldn’t have been without reason.

Without understanding these, the Immortal City’s Lord and the high-ranking powerhouses wouldn’t be able to sleep peacefully, let alone stabilize the situation in Cangwu Immortal City.

“City Lord…”

Yun Zhenzi, acting as the “housekeeper” of the dwelling, immediately opened the gate and came out.

If this were before, facing the joint arrival of the Immortal City’s Lord and other high-ranking powerhouses, Yun Zhenzi would be somewhat nervous, given that these were figures she could not even look up to a myriad of years ago.

Even among Jade Immortals, the gap would be even greater, and the former Yun Zhenzi, while strong among ordinary Jade Immortals, was far inferior to the top Jade Immortals.

And now, the current visitors are not just ordinary Jade Immortals, their backgrounds are incomparable to Yun Zhenzi’s.

But now?

Recalling Lin Yuan’s effortless grasp of the myriad demonic beings just a moment ago.

Yun Zhenzi stood up straight, with dignity and assertiveness, and said, “Gentlemen, what brings you here?”

“Is the master present inside?” The Immortal City’s Lord and other Jade Immortals exchanged looks, the City Lord spoke up proactively.

“The master is in seclusion,” Yun Zhenzi replied succinctly.

This was also instructed by Lin Yuan before he began his cultivation retreat, that anyone who wanted to visit him should be rejected under this pretext.

Unless something truly critical had occurred that affected the entirety of the Immortal City.

“In retreat?”

The lord of the Immortal City paused slightly, surprised.

The other giants behind him also felt a shiver in their hearts.

In retreat?

At a time like this?

Cangwu Immortal City had just survived a near-catastrophic crisis, and all immortals, including many top Jade Immortals like the city lord himself, could have been devoured by countless demonic creatures.

At this moment, for the many immortals, it was like escaping from the jaws of death, how could they possibly be in the mood for cultivation retreats?

Furthermore, the current situation outside the city was still unclear. If subsequent attacks by demonic creatures occurred, Cangwu Immortal City might be in danger again, making it even less likely for any immortals to enter retreat.

Yet, Lin Yuan was in retreat?

The response from Yun Zhenzi made the city lord and other high-level leaders reflect on many things.

Before they arrived, they had merely speculated that the owner of this A-grade cave dwelling might be related to the mysterious entity that dealt with the demonic creatures outside the city.

The likelihood was about forty to fifty percent.

But now, this probability had increased to seventy to eighty percent.

Because entering retreat at this moment was simply too unreasonable, unless one did not place these demonic creatures in his eyes at all.

And that matched the actions of the mysterious entity that intervened.

“May I inquire if your master… is aware of who took action against those demonic creatures outside the city just now?”

The lord of the Immortal City took a deep breath, carefully phrased his words, and asked cautiously.

“Who took action against the demonic creatures?”

Yun Zhenzi hesitated somewhat.

Of course, he knew who had acted.

It was Lin Yuan, who with a mere flip of his hand, had captured the boundless demonic creatures.

But Lin Yuan did not allow him to speak of this matter.

Nor did he forbid him from doing so.

That’s why Yun Zhenzi was hesitant.

“I will go and ask my master.” After much deliberation, Yun Zhenzi still decided to confirm with Lin Yuan.

“Go and ask the master!” The hearts of the city lord and other high-level leaders trembled once again.

Yun Zhenzi did not answer with ignorance.

But instead, he said he needed to ask the master.

What did this imply?

It meant that not only might the owner of the dwelling be aware, but even the servant before them likely knew who the mysterious entity that had acted was.

It was merely a matter of asking the master to see if it could be disclosed to outsiders.

“Very well, go and ask.”

“We will wait here.”

The lord of the Immortal City immediately forced a smile, and the other high-level leaders did the same.

At this moment, they harbored an even more terrifying conjecture.

Maybe the owner of this dwelling was not only related to that mysterious powerhouse, but perhaps he was the mysterious powerhouse himself?

…

Another side of the Immortal Realm.

This place is immensely dark and profound, filled with pitch-black Demonic Qi.

Endless demonic creatures are born here, fighting and dying.

This is the Demon Abyss.

The birthplace of all demonic beings, and also the resting place of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

Deep within the Demon Abyss, a colossal consciousness is slowly awakening.

The Demonic Qi it randomly released condensed into numerous demonic creatures, which fought and devoured each other, eventually giving rise to several Emperors of Demonic Beings.

“Hm?”

“One of my children has died?”

Suddenly, this immense consciousness noticed something.

A mass of Demonic Qi converged, forming a supreme throne upon which a figure appeared, sitting on the throne.

He is the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

For the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, the life and death of ordinary demonic beings are of little concern. Not to mention invading the Immortal Realm; even within the Demon Abyss, countless ordinary demons perish every moment.

But an Emperor of Demonic Beings?

Emperors of Demonic Beings could be considered the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss’s incarnations, also his children.

In the Demon Abyss, the Emperors are immortal; they are blessed and protected by the entire Abyss.

The collapse of an Emperor of Demonic Beings would alert the slumbering Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

“Who exactly is it that killed my child?”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss’s gaze was pitch-black as he began to trace the signs in the void, locking onto the final memories of the deceased Emperors of Demonic Beings.

“Is it there?”

The eyes of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss flickered with the visions experienced by the six deceased Emperors of Demonic Beings.

“Found it.”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss faintly locked onto a location.

However, just as the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss was about to pinpoint the exact coordinates, he suddenly sensed the spacetime turn nebulous, the coordinates he had locked onto abruptly splitting in two, then four, eight…

It was as if it existed in all spacetime.

Yet as if it existed in none at all.

“This?”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss revealed a look of confusion.
